args.command: ls -la /work/report.pdf 2>&1; echo "---"; command -v pdfinfo mutool qpdf python3 2>&1

if command -v pdfinfo >/dev/null 2>&1; then pdfinfo /work/report.pdf | grep -i '^Pages'; elif command -v mutool >/dev/null 2>&1; then mutool info /work/report.pdf | grep -i pages; else python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
data=open('/work/report.pdf','rb').read()
print("Pages:", len(re.findall(rb'/Type\s*/Page[^s]', data)))
EOF
fi
